entities.summary: Pierre Berdoy was a French photographer of architecture, design, still life and beauty. Winner of the Niépce Prize in 1967, he collaborated on projects with French magazines such as L'ŒIL (1960s), Elle, Madame Figaro (1980s) and other publications until the 2000s.
